life_event: Born in 1951. Abandoned by mother, lived with grandfather.
Arrested for violently assaulting a prostitute. Margaret Schaefer, a friend of his girlfriend (Barbara Scholz),was strangled

with her own bra after refusing Jack’s sexual acts, and stealing from her parents’ home under Jack’s orders. Death of Marcia Horveth, strangled with stockings and a necktie. Never 1974 accused of killing due to already having a life sentence. Was convicted of the murder of 18-year-old Margaret Schaefer and
sentenced to life in prison. Prison autobiography Fegefeur (Purgatory) became a best seller and

"Endstation Zuchthaus" (Terminus Prison), won a prestigious literary prize. 05/23/1990 Unterweger’s first release from prison. 1990 Brunhilde Masser found murdered. 1990 Jack was featured on talk shows and Fegefeur became a movie 2/1990 Jacks play Scream of Fear goes on tour.

Blanka Bockova’s body found in Prague. 06/11/1991 Jack arrives in Los Angeles 06/24/1991 Jack visited the LAPD Parker Center to obtain permission for ride along. Movie deal turned down by Dornhelm, a fellow Austrian who had 07/03/1991 successfully established himself in the Hollywood scene. Officers of the Criminal Investigation Bureau in Vienna questioned 10/22/ 1991 Unterweger about the Austrian murders.
Shannon Exley, Irene Rodriguez, and Peggy Booth from Los Angeles found strangled with bras, beaten and violated with tree limbs. 2/27/1992 FBI arrest Unterweger in Florida.
Unterweger deported to Austria. June 1994 Trial begins in Graz, Austria. 06/28/1994 Found guilty 9 counts of murder and sentenced to life in prison.
Unterweger commits suicide in a prison in Austria.
